top_choice_rationale: P005 recognizes a mature, fundamental account of how collateral values and borrowing capacity amplify macroeconomic shocks. Kiyotaki and Moore supply the canonical collateral mechanism, while Gertler's work makes financial amplification central to macroeconomic propagation; the bounded citation avoids claiming credit for all financial-friction models.
recusal_note: No direct conflict with the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. My principal listed co-author, Steven Kaplan, is not a proposed laureate; institutional and historical overlaps with committee colleagues do not establish a conflict.
